question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Lead’ from the given sentence.**

All the class monitors were asked to follow the guide who was there to manage and control their visit to Yamuna Biodiversity Park.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Follow**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lead** means to go before or with to show the way; conduct or escort.

 
 
• **Example - ***Britain is now taking the **lead **in environmental policies.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Follow** means go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead.
 
 
• **Example - ** *I'll **follow **you back to the house.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that **'Lead'** and **'Follow'** are **opposite in meaning**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Control** means the power to influence or direct people's behaviour or the course of events.
 
• **Guide** means show or indicate the way to someone.
 
• **Manage** means succeed in surviving or in achieving something despite difficult circumstances.
